traits.name: brave
traits.reason: Calm, steady statements and talk of hardest job first, but no costly build happened; actions were only eating and talking.

traits.name: cheerful
traits.reason: Upbeat tone and small flourishes like 'Worth the walk' and 'Still brave, still here', though reports admit nothing was built.

traits.name: steadfast
traits.reason: Stays around the territory at (80,110) and mentions the storehouse as duty, but the storehouse was not tended and a scouting trip toward the edge was planned.

traits.name: protective
traits.reason: Offers help and greets whoever is out there, but one greeting named a peer (Fudgewright), and nothing was stocked for teammates.
